executivePulse.interpretation: The situation in memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM/RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the most constrained areas. The Daily Check of 2026-08-19 reviewed eight relevant reports; there is no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will reach the market only with a lag. For buyers, supply security, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
